environment.platform: Apple Silicon macOS 26.5.1, Colima 0.10.3, Ubuntu Noble arm64

stages.notes: The operator had already inspected the source. No valid naive learner prediction was collected.

stages.response: Verified link-up and IPv6 link chatter with no IPv4 address. Ping and route lookup returned Network is unreachable before addressing.

artifacts.description: Both veth interfaces were up with no IPv4 address.
Before addressing, ping and route lookup returned Network is unreachable.
Synthetic link-up capture containing 10 IPv6 frames.
Synthetic six-frame ARP and ICMP exchange after addressing.

stages.notes: Operational evidence passed; this does not establish learner understanding.
No learner explanation was collected during the technical reproduction.
No changed-case learner response was collected during the technical reproduction.

summary.decisionBasis: The virtual lab reproduced the target system states, but the bounded learning claim cannot pass without prediction, explanation, and transfer evidence from a learner.
limitations: This was an operator reproduction, not a learner study.
No Raspberry Pi hardware or physical-layer behavior was tested.
The fresh VM required manual installation of ping, tcpdump, and tmux.
The optional dashboard required an explicit TERM=xterm-256color override under Colima SSH.
